items.prompt: White's c-pawn is gone and Black has pawns on c6 and d5 (the Carlsbad structure). White to move: choose a move that fits White's usual plans here.

claims.statement: b4, Na4 and Bxe4 are within 40 centipawns of the best move.
g4 is at least 300 centipawns worse than the best move.

hints: Which side of the board has the pawn majority, and which side has the target on c6?
White's usual ideas are to advance the queenside pawns or to trade a pair of pieces.
b4 starts the push; Na4 heads for the queenside; Bxe4 trades.
items.explain: In this structure White usually plays on the queenside or trades pieces. At depth 16 the engine puts b4, Na4 and Bxe4 within 40 centipawns of one another. The kingside pawn push g4 is at least 300 centipawns lower.

feedback_by_move.g2g4: A kingside pawn storm. The engine rates it at least 300 centipawns below the plan moves at depth 16.

items.prompt: Black to move in the same structure. Choose a move that fits Black's usual plans.

claims.statement: Ng6 and Ne4 are within 40 centipawns of the best move.
c5 is at least 150 centipawns worse than the best move.

hints: White's plan is on the queenside. Where can Black's pieces do more?
Black usually brings a knight toward the kingside or trades a pair of pieces.
The knight from f8 goes to g6, or the f6 knight goes to e4.
items.explain: Black usually repositions a knight or trades pieces rather than breaking in the centre. At depth 16 the engine puts Ng6 and Ne4 first, and the early pawn break c5 at least 150 centipawns lower.

feedback_by_move.c6c5: An early pawn break. The engine rates it at least 150 centipawns below Ng6 or Ne4 at depth 16.

items.prompt: White owns the isolated d-pawn: no white pawn stands on the c or e file. Choose a move that fits the owner's usual plan: keep pieces on and aim them at the king.

claims.statement: Bb1 and Be4 are within 40 centipawns of the best move.
Bxh7+ is at least 300 centipawns worse than the best move.

hints: The owner's pieces replace the missing pawn support. Where do they aim?
A bishop can line up with the queen toward the h7 square.
items.explain: With the d-pawn isolated, its owner usually keeps pieces on and aims them at the king. At depth 16 the engine puts Bb1 and Be4 within 40 centipawns of each other. The immediate sacrifice Bxh7+ is at least 300 centipawns lower.

feedback_by_move.d3h7: Too early: the engine rates it at least 300 centipawns below the plan moves at depth 16.

items.prompt: Black faces White's isolated d4 pawn. Choose a move that fits Black's usual plan against it.

claims.statement: Qa5, Bd7, Qb6 and Nce7 are within 40 centipawns of the best move.
Nxd4 is at least 300 centipawns worse than the best move.

hints: The isolated pawn is a target, but pieces defend it. What can you add to the pressure?
Develop a piece or bring the queen to the pressure points.
items.explain: Against an isolated pawn, Black usually adds pressure and improves pieces. At depth 16 the engine puts these four moves within 40 centipawns of one another. Grabbing the pawn at once with Nxd4 is at least 300 centipawns lower.

feedback_by_move.c6d4: It takes the pawn, but the engine rates it at least 300 centipawns below the plan moves at depth 16.

items.prompt: White plays b4, the queenside pawn push. Does it work here? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: b4 is at least 300 centipawns worse than the best move.

hints: Which white pieces does the push leave without support?
Compare with the structure where b4 is a normal plan.
items.explain: The push that is a normal plan in the Carlsbad structure loses material here: the engine rates b4 at least 300 centipawns below White's best move at depth 16. A plan belongs to a structure.

items.prompt: The centre is open and the e-file is half open; a black knight stands on e4. White to move: choose a move that fits an open-centre plan.

claims.statement: Re1 is the engine's first choice.
d5 is at least 60 centipawns worse than the best move.
c3 is at least 60 centipawns worse than the best move.

hints: Which file is open or half open? Which of your pieces is not on it?
In an open position, a rook on an open file often decides.
items.explain: Re1 puts a rook on the open file and attacks the knight. At depth 16 the engine ranks it first, ahead of the closing pawn moves d5 and c3, which are at least 60 centipawns lower.

feedback_by_move.d4d5: It closes the centre again. The engine rates it at least 60 centipawns below Re1 at depth 16.
feedback_by_move.c2c3: A quiet pawn move. The engine rates it at least 60 centipawns below Re1 at depth 16.

items.prompt: Black to move. Choose a good move.

claims.statement: O-O, Bd7, Nf6 and Bf6 are within 40 centipawns of the best move.

hints: Look at White's pawns. Which one has no neighbours?
Finish development and keep the blockade on d5.
items.explain: Black completes development against the isolated pawn. At depth 16 the engine puts O-O, Bd7, Nf6 and Bf6 within 40 centipawns of one another.
